name: wp-ai-evals-workspace
description: Development workspace for automattic/ai-evals and the Hello Dolly AI example.

scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run typecheck && npm run build && composer check
scripts.demo:setup: npm run build && php scripts/stage-demo-package.php && composer update automattic/ai-evals --working-dir=examples/hello-dolly-ai --no-interaction --no-audit && npm install --prefix examples/hello-dolly-ai && npm run build --prefix examples/hello-dolly-ai
scripts.demo:check: npm run check && npm run check --prefix examples/hello-dolly-ai && vendor/bin/phpunit -c examples/hello-dolly-ai/phpunit.xml.dist
